title: Taxi to the train station
show: Original, in the style of a city drama

paraphrase.pinyin: nín hǎo, nín xiǎng qù nǎlǐ?
paraphrase.english: Hello, where would you like to go?

swap.changes: the driver guesses a destination: the airport

reply.hanzi: 不是，师傅，去火车站。我的火车十点开，现在已经九点了。
reply.pinyin: bú shì, shīfu, qù huǒchēzhàn. wǒ de huǒchē shí diǎn kāi, xiànzài yǐjīng jiǔ diǎn le.
reply.english: No, driver, to the train station. My train leaves at ten and it's already nine.

detour.hanzi: 您好，请上车。今天天气很好，是不是？
detour.pinyin: nín hǎo, qǐng shàng chē. jīntiān tiānqì hěn hǎo, shì bu shì?
detour.english: Hello, hop in. Nice weather today, isn't it?

detour.hanzi: 是，天气很好，就是有点儿热。
detour.pinyin: shì, tiānqì hěn hǎo, jiùshì yǒudiǎnr rè.
detour.english: Yes, it's nice, just a bit hot.

steerBack.pinyin: duì, jīntiān zhēn rè. nín qù nǎr?
steerBack.english: Right, it's really hot today. Where to?

lines.hanzi: 师傅，去火车站。我的火车十点开，现在已经九点了。
lines.pinyin: shīfu, qù huǒchēzhàn. wǒ de huǒchē shí diǎn kāi, xiànzài yǐjīng jiǔ diǎn le.
lines.english: Driver, to the train station please. My train leaves at ten and it's already nine.

lines.hanzi: 九点了？路上车不多的话，二十分钟就到。
lines.pinyin: jiǔ diǎn le? lùshang chē bù duō de huà, èrshí fēnzhōng jiù dào.
lines.english: Nine already? If there aren't many cars on the road, we'll be there in twenty minutes.

paraphrase.hanzi: 九点？路上车少的话，二十分钟就能到。
paraphrase.pinyin: jiǔ diǎn? lùshang chē shǎo de huà, èrshí fēnzhōng jiù néng dào.
paraphrase.english: Nine? If the road is quiet, we can be there in twenty minutes.

swap.changes: travel time: twenty minutes becomes forty because of traffic
swap.hanzi: 九点了？这个时候车很多，要四十分钟。
swap.pinyin: jiǔ diǎn le? zhège shíhou chē hěn duō, yào sìshí fēnzhōng.
swap.english: Nine already? There are lots of cars at this time, it'll take forty minutes.

reply.hanzi: 四十分钟？那太慢了！师傅，能快一点儿吗？火车不会等我。
reply.pinyin: sìshí fēnzhōng? nà tài màn le! shīfu, néng kuài yìdiǎnr ma? huǒchē bú huì děng wǒ.
reply.english: Forty minutes? That's too slow! Driver, can you go a bit faster? The train won't wait for me.

detour.pinyin: jiǔ diǎn le? nín yǒu piào le ma?
detour.english: Nine already? Do you have your ticket yet?
Yes, the ticket is on my phone.

steerBack.hanzi: 好。路上车不多的话，二十分钟就到。
steerBack.pinyin: hǎo. lùshang chē bù duō de huà, èrshí fēnzhōng jiù dào.
steerBack.english: Good. If there aren't many cars on the road, we'll be there in twenty minutes.

lines.hanzi: 太好了！能快一点儿吗？火车不会等我。
lines.pinyin: tài hǎo le! néng kuài yìdiǎnr ma? huǒchē bú huì děng wǒ.
lines.english: Great! Can you go a bit faster? The train won't wait for me.

lines.hanzi: 好，我走左边的路，会快一点儿。可以吗？
lines.pinyin: hǎo, wǒ zǒu zuǒbian de lù, huì kuài yìdiǎnr. kěyǐ ma?
lines.english: Okay, I'll take the road on the left, it'll be a bit faster. Is that all right?

paraphrase.hanzi: 好的，我从左边走，那边会快一点儿，可以吗？
paraphrase.pinyin: hǎo de, wǒ cóng zuǒbian zǒu, nàbian huì kuài yìdiǎnr, kěyǐ ma?
paraphrase.english: Sure, I'll go by the left side, it's a bit faster that way. Is that all right?

swap.changes: route: the road on the left becomes the road on the right
swap.hanzi: 好，我走右边的路，会快一点儿。可以吗？
swap.pinyin: hǎo, wǒ zǒu yòubian de lù, huì kuài yìdiǎnr. kěyǐ ma?
swap.english: Okay, I'll take the road on the right, it'll be a bit faster. Is that all right?

reply.hanzi: 可以，那就走右边，我听您的。
reply.pinyin: kěyǐ, nà jiù zǒu yòubian, wǒ tīng nín de.
reply.english: Sure, then let's go right. I'll go with whatever you say.

detour.hanzi: 好。您是不是第一次来这儿？
detour.pinyin: hǎo. nín shì bu shì dì yī cì lái zhèr?
detour.english: Okay. Is this your first time here?

detour.hanzi: 不是，我在这儿工作，但是不太认识路。
detour.pinyin: bú shì, wǒ zài zhèr gōngzuò, dànshì bú tài rènshi lù.
detour.english: No, I work here, but I don't really know the roads.

steerBack.hanzi: 没问题，我认识路。我走左边的路，可以吗？
steerBack.pinyin: méi wèntí, wǒ rènshi lù. wǒ zǒu zuǒbian de lù, kěyǐ ma?
steerBack.english: No problem, I know the way. I'll take the road on the left, is that all right?

lines.hanzi: 可以，您知道怎么走，我听您的。
lines.pinyin: kěyǐ, nín zhīdao zěnme zǒu, wǒ tīng nín de.
lines.english: Sure. You know the way, I'll go with whatever you say.

lines.hanzi: 火车站有两个门，您去哪个门？
lines.pinyin: huǒchēzhàn yǒu liǎng ge mén, nín qù nǎge mén?
lines.english: The station has two gates. Which gate are you going to?

paraphrase.hanzi: 您在哪个门下车？火车站有两个门。
paraphrase.pinyin: nín zài nǎge mén xiàchē? huǒchēzhàn yǒu liǎng ge mén.
paraphrase.english: Which gate do you want to get out at? The station has two gates.

swap.changes: question: 'which gate' becomes a choice between the east gate and the west gate
swap.hanzi: 火车站有两个门，您去东门还是西门？
swap.pinyin: huǒchēzhàn yǒu liǎng ge mén, nín qù dōngmén háishi xīmén?
swap.english: The station has two gates. Are you going to the east gate or the west gate?

reply.hanzi: 东门。我朋友在那儿等我。
reply.pinyin: dōngmén. wǒ péngyou zài nàr děng wǒ.
reply.english: The east gate. My friend is waiting for me there.

detour.pinyin: nín yí ge rén zuò huǒchē ma?
detour.english: Are you taking the train on your own?

detour.hanzi: 不是，我和朋友一起去北京。
detour.pinyin: bú shì, wǒ hé péngyou yìqǐ qù běijīng.
detour.english: No, I'm going to Beijing with a friend.

steerBack.hanzi: 好。火车站有两个门，您去哪个门？
steerBack.pinyin: hǎo. huǒchēzhàn yǒu liǎng ge mén, nín qù nǎge mén?
steerBack.english: Good. The station has two gates. Which gate are you going to?

lines.hanzi: 去东门，我朋友在那儿等我。
lines.pinyin: qù dōngmén, wǒ péngyou zài nàr děng wǒ.
lines.english: To the east gate. My friend is waiting for me there.
We're at the east gate. Thirty yuan.

paraphrase.pinyin: dào dōngmén le, yào sānshí kuài qián.
paraphrase.english: We've reached the east gate. That's thirty yuan.

swap.english: We're at the east gate. Forty yuan.

reply.hanzi: 给您，四十块。谢谢师傅，再见！
reply.pinyin: gěi nín, sìshí kuài. xièxie shīfu, zàijiàn!
reply.english: Here you go, forty yuan. Thanks, driver. Bye!

detour.pinyin: dōngmén dào le. nín yǒu língqián ma?
detour.english: We're at the east gate. Do you have small change?

lines.hanzi: 给您，三十块。谢谢师傅，再见！
lines.pinyin: gěi nín, sānshí kuài. xièxie shīfu, zàijiàn!
lines.english: Here you go, thirty yuan. Thanks, driver. Bye!

vocabExceptions.reason: The everyday way to address a taxi driver; 傅 is outside HSK 1-2 but the scene sounds wrong without it.
